purpose: Test whether public repeated interaction data can place real island systems on separate outcome-independent breadth and synchrony axes required by the combined theory manuscript.
nonnegotiable_boundaries: Do not map natural partner richness or Hill diversity literally onto synthetic k.
Do not use reproductive or performance outcomes to admit, exclude, tune, or classify a system in the context plane.
Do not count data unavailability as a biological negative.
Do not retune the frozen synthetic model from natural placements.
Do not change the frozen 25-entry island identifiability denominator or its 0/25 full-contract result.
Do not select time bins, taxa, sites, or sources based on the observed breadth/synchrony location.

hard_admission_requirements.interaction_type: biotic interaction counts or rates with identifiable partner taxa or interaction identities
hard_admission_requirements.sampling_effort: known, equal by design, or explicitly normalizable within system across time

coordinate_definition.effort_standardized_matrix: x[t,j] = interaction count or rate for partner j in time bin t after source-native effort normalization
coordinate_definition.partner_breadth_primary: D1 = exp(-sum_j p_j log(p_j)), where p_j is the pooled effort-standardized interaction share of partner j
coordinate_definition.synchrony_primary: Loreau-de Mazancourt style phi = Var_t(sum_j x[t,j]) / (sum_j SD_t(x[t,j]))^2 using nonconstant partner series
coordinate_definition.synchrony_secondary: mean off-diagonal pairwise correlation among eligible standardized partner time series using Fisher-z averaging when defined
coordinate_definition.exchangeable_equivalent_bridge: rho_eq = (m*phi - 1)/(m - 1), where m is the number of eligible partner series; rho_eq is descriptive only and is not treated as a literal natural pairwise correlation

uncertainty.small_sample_rule: Systems passing the six-bin floor remain admissible but are flagged low_precision if either primary coordinate has a bootstrap interval spanning more than half of the observed cross-system range.

source_dependence_controls.primary_dispersion_summary: source-balanced; each study receives equal total weight

fallback_Oikos_plus_EL.condition: by hard stop, fewer than 8 admitted island systems OR fewer than 2 independent source studies OR fewer than 2 island/archipelago groups
fallback_Oikos_plus_EL.action: abandon combined submission route; restore closed island manuscript to Oikos and theory manuscript to Ecology Letters

NEE_candidate.two_dimensionality: absolute source-balanced Spearman correlation between log_D1 and phi <= 0.80
NEE_candidate.interior_occupancy: at least 20% of admitted systems lie within the joint 25th-75th percentile rectangle of log_D1 and phi
NEE_candidate.source_robustness: NEE numerical thresholds remain satisfied after leaving out the single largest source study, except that sample-count minima may decrease by that source's contribution
NEE_candidate.action: promote combined manuscript to NEE Article/Analysis candidate

Ecology_Letters_combined.condition: public data pass fallback minima but one or more NEE_candidate dispersion/source-robustness criteria fail
Ecology_Letters_combined.action: retain combined manuscript but target Ecology Letters; natural regime placement is supporting rather than ceiling-raising evidence

search_order: known public repeated island pollination datasets
Mangal datasets/networks with repeated dates and island locations
Web of Life / IWDB sources only when repeated source-native matrices can be reconstructed
stop_early_if: NEE_candidate criteria are already satisfied and leave-one-source-out robustness is evaluable
all discoverable eligible source classes have been exhausted
